🐞 fix(setFocus): focus the first enabled option in radio and checkbox groups (#13968)

setFocus always focused the first registered option of a radio or
checkbox group. When that option is disabled, focus() does nothing and
focus stays where it was. Error focus already skips disabled options
since #13960; setFocus now does the same, and still falls back to the
first option when every option is disabled.
